ap_diagnostic_not_the_number_of_record.method: single-class AP@IoU=0.5, all-points PR interpolation, independently reimplemented (not ultralytics' own validator)
ap_diagnostic_not_the_number_of_record.sanity_check_verdict: *** LARGE DEVIATION -- investigate before trusting the bootstrap ***
ap_diagnostic_not_the_number_of_record.note: Two independent bugs were found and fixed in this reimplementation (ground-truth frame mismatch: 0.593->0.701; NMS iou 0.5->0.7 per the detector's own recorded config, which moved it further away: 0.701->0.672) without converging on 0.8100. Kept as a disclosed diagnostic rather than discarded; the recall-based primary_result above is the trustworthy interval and does not depend on this AP reimplementation being correct.
